title: How to Choose the Right Research Topic
shortDescription: A practical framework for selecting a research topic that matters.
description: Choosing the right research topic is the foundation of a successful study. This article walks through a practical framework covering relevance, feasibility, and originality to help early-career researchers make confident decisions.
author: Dr. Momena Begum

title: 5 Common Mistakes in Manuscript Writing
shortDescription: Avoid these pitfalls that lead to manuscript rejection.
description: Reviewers often reject manuscripts for avoidable reasons. This article breaks down the five most common mistakes researchers make and how to fix them before submission.
author: Dr. Momena Begum

title: Understanding P-Values: A Practical Guide
shortDescription: Demystifying one of the most misunderstood statistical concepts.
description: P-values are widely used but frequently misinterpreted. This guide explains what a p-value actually tells you and how to report it correctly in your research.
author: Research Academy Team

title: AI Tools Every Researcher Should Know in 2026
shortDescription: A curated list of AI tools accelerating modern research.
description: From literature screening to data visualization, AI tools are transforming how research is conducted. This article curates the most useful tools for 2026.
author: Research Academy Team

title: Navigating the IRB Approval Process
shortDescription: A step-by-step guide to getting ethical clearance for your study.
description: The IRB approval process can feel daunting for first-time researchers. This guide simplifies each step, from submission to approval.
author: Dr. Momena Begum
